# requireValidSheetName

<link-summary>Returns the value as a sheet name, or throws.</link-summary>

<web-summary>requireValidSheetName() — Returns the value as a sheet name, or throws. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function requireValidSheetName(
  value: unknown,
  message: string = "Expected a valid sheet name."
): string;
```

What Google Sheets accepts: at most 100 characters, not blank, none of `\ / ? * [ ]`, and not the reserved name `history` in any case.

`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter                                                 | Type      | Description                                                   |
| :-------------------------------------------------------- | :-------- | :------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `value`                                                   | `unknown` | The value to validate.                                        |
| `message` _(optional)_ `= "Expected a valid sheet name."` | `string`  | The message of the exception. A default is used when omitted. |

## Returns

`string` — the same value, typed as a sheet name.

## Throws

| Exception                  | Condition                      |
| :------------------------- | :----------------------------- |
| `IllegalArgumentException` | the value is not a sheet name. |

## Examples

### What passes and what does not

```javascript
requireValidSheetName("Data"); // => "Data"
requireValidSheetName("Report 2026"); // => "Report 2026"
requireValidSheetName("history"); // throws IllegalArgumentException
requireValidSheetName("Data/2026"); // throws IllegalArgumentException
```
